title: Knowledge inbox leaves the menu until it has sources and postmortems read in plain words

problem_register_binding.operator_approval: 2026-11-25 conversation 52a1dacf (照建議 全部處理好)
problem_register_binding.hosted_read_only_diagnosis: 2026-11-25 06:35Z to 07:16Z on BFF adc027da9: GET /bff/knowledge returned meta.status ok while surfaces knowledge_inbox_insights and knowledge_inbox_memory were unavailable with source missing (pinned by BFF-KNOWLEDGE-EMPTY-NOT-UNAVAILABLE-20261105), causing the frontend to claim 'Inbox zero.' while exposing four promote buttons without an executing owner; /management/postmortems mixed 5355 infrastructure-health/monitor-agent drafts with 103 strategy drafts and displayed 'Postmortem draft:' prefixes, machine root-cause sentences, and raw key=value strings.

details: Removed the 'knowledge' entry from MANAGEMENT_SIDEBAR_GROUPS in src/management/navigation/managementRouteManifest.ts, which serves as the single source of truth for both the management sidebar (ManagementLayout.tsx) and the command palette static jump-to entries (CommandPalette.tsx).

Changed '/management/knowledge' in scripts/lib/management-routes.mjs from kind 'nav' to kind 'detail-or-alias' so the direct route stays in the crawl inventory while not being expected in live sidebar navigation.

KnowledgeInbox.tsx extracts source status issues from meta.surfaces (knowledge_inbox_notes, knowledge_inbox_insights, knowledge_inbox_memory, plus fallback degraded_sources), listing each source that is not connected (source === 'missing') or failed (status !== 'ok' / source === 'unavailable') with localized labels in zh-TW and en-US.
KnowledgeInbox.tsx renders data-testid='knowledge-inbox-empty' only when every source was read (!isUnavailable and sourceIssues.length === 0) and items.length === 0.
Removed all four NonProductionActionButton promote/dismiss buttons without an executing owner from KnowledgeInbox.tsx.

postmortemClient.ts supports include_infrastructure in PostmortemListQuery (sending include_infrastructure='true' only when enabled) and normalizes meta.hidden_infrastructure_count (preserving non-negative integer, null, or undefined when absent).

PostmortemLibrary.tsx shows strategy incidents by default (includeInfrastructure=false) and renders a toggle button (data-testid='postmortem-infra-toggle') showing meta.hidden_infrastructure_count when a non-negative number is present (e.g. 'Show system incidents (5355)' / '顯示系統異常草稿（5355）').
When meta.hidden_infrastructure_count is null or absent, the toggle shows no number ('Show system incidents' / '顯示系統異常草稿') and the page remains fully usable.

formatPostmortemTitle and plainPostmortemTitle strip the automatic 'Postmortem draft:' / '事後檢討草稿：' prefix and translate recorded drift kinds (runtime_state, drawdown, fill_price, duplicate_execution, rolling_drawdown_multiple, and all tradeJourneys/enumLabels kinds) and downstream degradation service names into plain zh-TW and en-US titles, rendering binding_id or service slug as secondary text (data-testid='postmortem-secondary-context') and keeping raw text in secondary for unknown kinds.

Each row renders a direct Link to /management/incidents/:incident_id (data-testid='postmortem-incident-link') with the incident_id as secondary text (data-testid='postmortem-secondary-incident-id') and the created/published timestamp.

formatPostmortemRootCause replaces the machine pending sentence ('Draft generated from resolved incident ...; root cause pending analysis.') with localized plain text ('Root cause has not been analysed yet.' / '尚未分析根因。').

partitionContributingFactors and resolveClusterDisplay translate structured contributing factors (incident_severity, incident_cluster_id including all recorded drift:* kinds such as drift:runtime_state, drift:drawdown, drift:fill_price, drift:duplicate_execution, drift:rolling_drawdown_multiple, and infrastructure:*, plus plain incident_evidence_summary) into localized labels in zh-TW and en-US, keeping unknown cluster raw tokens as secondary text (data-testid='postmortem-factor-secondary') and all raw key=value strings and technical identifiers inside a collapsed-by-default <details data-testid='postmortem-technical-details'> section.

Contributing factor labels, default follow-up action items ('Complete root cause analysis', 'Validate remediation against linked telemetry and reconciliation evidence'), author ('postmortem-draft-worker'), and deployment stage ('paper', 'live', 'research', 'canary', 'shadow') are translated in zh-TW and en-US.

Both the page header bar (data-testid='postmortem-no-review-flow-notice') and the draft detail sheet (data-testid='postmortem-detail-draft-notice') state that postmortem drafts are read-only and have no review or publish flow connected yet.

All loading, empty, and error texts in KnowledgeInbox.tsx and PostmortemLibrary.tsx are localized in zh-TW.ts and en-US.ts with 1:1 global key symmetry verified by src/lib/v5/management/__tests__/i18nParity.test.ts.

At 1274x627 in real Chromium, the postmortem table uses table-fixed with constrained percentage column widths (42% / 11% / 22% / 25%) so table.scrollWidth <= card.clientWidth (no horizontal scroll and the Time column is never cut off), every row is <= 80px high (measured 53px), and <main> is the single vertical scroll area.

changed_assertions_justification.change: Updated row title expectations in AC1, AC2, and AC4 tests from 'Postmortem draft: BFF downstream degradation: ...' to plain localized 'Downstream service degradation' / 'Downstream service degradation: Training session' / '下游服務連線異常：訓練工作階段服務' with the service/row token in secondary text (plus asserting 'Postmortem draft:' is absent), and updated the AC4 detail root-cause expectation from the raw machine sentence 'Draft generated from resolved incident inc-training-session-001; root cause pending analysis.' to 'Root cause has not been analysed yet.' / '尚未分析根因。' (plus asserting the raw machine sentence is absent).
changed_assertions_justification.reason: Per AC3, a postmortem row now shows a plain localized title without the 'Postmortem draft:' prefix and keeps raw service/binding tokens as secondary text, and the detail view says the root cause is not analysed yet instead of the machine sentence.

changed_assertions_justification.change: Expanded the Postmortem loading and empty/error regexes at lines 430-435 to match the localized zh-TW and en-US strings ('No postmortems recorded' / '尚無事後檢討紀錄' / 'Could not load postmortems' / '無法載入事後檢討' / '載入事後檢討中').
changed_assertions_justification.reason: Per AC4, loading, empty, and error texts on PostmortemLibraryPage are now localized in zh-TW and en-US.

validation.result: 3 passed (canonical reads, lineage lookup, and knowledge inbox + postmortem truth with 1274x627 table-fixed layout, plain drift/service titles, and re-captured screenshots)

diff_budget_note: scripts/git/diff_budget.py is a pantheon-repo script and does not exist in execute-plans; git diff --shortstat origin/dev reports 19 scoped files changed across product, i18n, unit/e2e tests, and 1274x627 evidence screenshots.
